registered.flash_loop_tolerances: 1e-10 (PT and PH, external and internal), 1000 iterations
registered.floor_rerun: the selected column tolerance times 10, everything else unchanged

column_method_order_amendment_1.order: levels L1 then L2; within a level, tolerances tightest first; within a tolerance, the methods in this order
column_method_order_amendment_1.reason: Russell inside-out does not exist in DWSIM 9.0.5; Burningham-Otto runs only in AbsorptionColumn, which has no condenser and no reboiler (spec §17.2)

settings.recovery_percent_conversion: DWSIM Component_Recovery value = 100 x the registered recovery fraction (spec §17.4)
settings.column_other: DWSIM defaults (SolverScheme, Broyden acceleration, internal initial estimates); stage efficiency 1; CondenserDeltaP 0

sign_conversion: Q_condenser = -1000 E(Q-COND) and Q_reboiler = +1000 E(Q-REB), W, Q > 0 into the stage; E in kW as DWSIM reports its energy streams (condenser: heat removed; reboiler: heat supplied)

case_definition.intermediate_duties_W: 0 on every stage that carries no end specification
